# Chapter 1: The Disaster · Ride Script

Nov 9, 2026 · @Chris Smyth

A 35-minute intro ride: easy hangar warm-up, short escape surges, a stealth power-up on an ice moon, a debris race, one climb and the first sight of the gate.

## How to read this

Each row is a beat pinned to the clock. Everything comes from Chris's two drafts and what we agreed on 8–9 November, except lines in *italics*, which Claude added to fill gaps. Keep, change or cut them.

- **Workout** is the target as % of FTP. Short bursts run with ERG off, and every surge gets a spin-up cue about 5 seconds before.
- **Glass** means the AI writing in the canopy condensation, the only safe channel until Act 3.
- **Crush is the pilot's callsign. She's a gas-giant fuel scooper who races with her work crew, the Divers. Chapter 1 never explains the name**. The pilot's lines are recorded in male and female versions.

## Act 1 · The disaster (00:00–16:30)

A long, easy warm-up in the hangar, a launch that feels fast but stays at tempo, short escape surges, then a blackout.

## Act 2 · The ice moon (16:30–31:30)

The ship wakes one system at a time, the debris race brings three impacts of rising size, and one climb ends in a 30-second boost.

| Time | Workout | What we see | What we hear | Dialogue | HUD / gameplay |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 16:30 | 55% | Fog thins in one corner: an ice sheet under pale haze | Wind against the hull | **Glass:** SPIN THE TURBINES UP. GENTLY. | Power range appears; heat gauge live |
| 17:30 | 62% | The ship levels and lifts into a hover | Turbines hum awake | *Glass: COLD HIDES US. NOTHING HERE TRANSMITS.* | Cadence readout comes back |
| 18:30 | 68% | Gliding low over the ice | Low wind | *Glass: STAY IN THE RANGE. HEAT GIVES US AWAY.* | Watts readout and target band come back |
| 19:30 | 74% | Horizon opens: Terror's ice sheet, with Erebus filling the sky | Faint music returns | — | Map and heading restored; HUD complete |
| 20:30 | 70% | Impact 1, far off: a burning station terrace hits the ice; steam towers up | A delayed boom rolls in | **Glass:** *STATION DEBRIS.* / *SOMETHING IS READING OUR EMISSIONS. I DON'T KNOW WHAT.* / USE THE IMPACTS AS COVER. | Predicted impact markers appear |
| 21:30 | 30 s at 100% | Dash towards the steam cloud | Wind roar | *Glass: GO.* | Heat climbs; cover marker |
| 22:00 | 82% for 1:30 | Inside the steam: white-out, glowing metal looming | Hissing; ticking metal | *Glass: HIDDEN. PUSH.* | Heat masked inside the cloud, so the band rises |
| 23:30 | 30 s at 115%, ERG off | Impact 2, close: a structure slams into the ice ahead; shards and steam | Massive impact; ice cracking | *Glass: MOVE.* | Spin-up cue at 23:25; screen shake |
| 24:00 | 70% for 1:30 | Weaving between craters; a huge frozen wave on the horizon | Music builds | — | Heading set for the frozen wave |
| 25:30 | 30 s at 120%, ERG off | The big one: our hangar section falls. We glimpse our faction symbol on its wall as it hits | Impact, then silence | — | Spin-up cue at 25:25 |
| 26:00 | 65% | We pass a downed race ship, its lights blinking | Quiet | **Glass:** THE LIGHTS ARE A MESSAGE. PILOT ALIVE. SEDATED. FLIGHT INOPERABLE. SEND HELP. | Ship tagged for rescue |
| 26:40 | 65% | The same symbol as our helmet is painted on its wing | — | *Crush (barely a whisper): "...that's one of ours."* | Team-mate marker saved |
| 27:00 | 75% → 90%, +5% a minute | The climb up the frozen wave: rough ice, shards exploding from the turbines; ice cracks ahead, threatening the runway | Shaking; cracking | — | Gradient shown |
| 29:30 | 85–90% | The AI initialises new ship modes | Rising tones | — | HUD changes colour; new symbols; a bizarre gate overlay flashes, then vanishes |
| 31:00 | 30 s at 118%, ERG off | The ice explodes beneath us as we launch off the crest into the clouds | Roar | *Glass: NOW.* | Spin-up cue at 30:55 |

## Act 3 · The gate (31:30–35:00)

The cool-down: the AI speaks aloud for the first time, and the gate rises into view.

| Time | Workout | What we see | What we hear | Dialogue | HUD / gameplay |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 31:30 | 60% | Up through the clouds and the upper atmosphere, into the dark | Wind fades to silence | *Glass: THEY CAN'T HEAR US UP HERE.* | The glass clears |
| 32:30 | 55% | Slingshot around Erebus's night side | Music swells softly | **AI** *(aloud, gently)*: "We should be able to talk now." *AI: "Nine hours to our destination. Rest."* | Time-jump fade |
| 33:30 | 52% | Night; stars | Quiet | **Crush:** "I'm too... numb to talk." *(a beat)* "They're gone, aren't they?" | — |
| 34:15 | 45% | We bank upwards and the gate rises into view: staggering, alien-looking, ominous and beautiful | Music peaks, then drops away | **AI:** "Yes, Crush. They're all gone." | Gate destination marker |
| 35:00 | Ride ends | Cut to black. End of chapter 1 | — | — | Ride summary |

## Open decisions

- [ ] Why she's called Crush, revealed in a later chapter: "Is it true they call you Crush because..."
- [ ] Sarah is the crew's engineer, not a diver, so she watches the race from Observation Deck 4
- [ ] Divers' symbol and motto (provisional): a cracked dive helmet with "SAFETY LAST", on Crush's helmet and the team-mate's wing
- [ ] Helmet update: Dax installed it, and its changelog is the first clue. Dates use the AS (After Singularity) calendar with the Earth year flashing beside it, roughly 800 years from now. Still to pick: the AS year and the update number
- [ ] Named: Erebus (gas giant) and Terror (ice moon, "the Ice" in crew slang). Still to name: the gate
- [ ] Team-mate: rescued in an optional side mission that unlocks their flight footage of our escape. By then the ice moon has been transformed by the impacts and the blast's radiation, and returning is extremely dangerous. Name: Frobisher, "Froby". Skills and backstory to decide
- [ ] Locked for now: "They're all gone" stays, and the AI is proved wrong later when the Roll gets an answer
